approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
cadence: every technical post carries one card; no standalone cadence
first_installment_sketch: Proof card for the @graph flattening incident (directive sec 2 and sec 22): CLAIM that the flattener processes all graph nodes; STATUS PROVEN; TEST the recursive-processing fixture; RESULT failed before the fix, passes after; FAILURE MODE silent fact loss on nested graph nodes; LIMITATION fixture-scoped, not a claim about every extractor path. Grounded in the directive's own example; exact commit to be pinned from the repo at write time.
inputs: an engineering claim cleared through claim verification (SUPPORTED, EVIDENCE, SOURCE, FRESH, DIRECT/DERIVED/INFERRED, not contradicted)
the commit, fixture, environment and test that back it
the known failure mode and limitation
name: PROOF CARDS
outputs: a proof card block embedded in the published post
purpose: Make every technical post carry a compact, recognizable proof block so readers can verify claims instead of trusting adjectives.
template: Block fields in fixed order: CLAIM / STATUS (one of PROVEN, MEASURED, EXPERIMENTAL, PARTIAL, PLANNED, UNKNOWN, FALSIFIED; never blurred) / COMMIT / ENVIRONMENT / TEST / RESULT / FAILURE MODE / REPRODUCE / LIMITATION. The card states the boundary the claim does not cross. If a measurement or fixture does not exist, the STATUS is UNKNOWN or PLANNED and the card says what would prove it. The card is editorial branding: same shape, every post.
